n3566ab6614.headline: Bolsonaro appoints army reserve general to head Petrobras
n3566ab6614.summary: Brazil's government appointed Joaquim Silva e Luna, an army reserve general, as the new president of Petrobras, succeeding Roberto Castello Branco after more than two years in the role.
n3566ab6614.why: Petrobras is Brazil's state-controlled oil giant and a key player in the country's energy sector and economy. Leadership changes can affect company strategy and investor confidence.

impacts.name: Petrobras
impacts.why: Change in leadership at Brazil's largest oil company can influence strategy and market perception.

n35a14811ec.headline: A week in the red for the Casablanca Stock Exchange
n35a14811ec.summary: The Casablanca Stock Exchange's main index, Masi, fell 0.77% to 11,467.04 points during the week of February 15-19, 2021.
n35a14811ec.why: The Casablanca Stock Exchange is Morocco's main equity market, reflecting economic and investor sentiment in the region.
